flagged.title: Chapters 6-8: The Chase
flagged.reason: The video systematically misnumbers the chapters across the entire lesson and presents an erroneous 'insider tip' distinguishing Chapter 5 from Chapter 6 that will cause students to be marked wrong on lesson questions.

mark_affecting.quote: So in chapter 5, we arrive at Pondicherry Lodge to find Bartholomew Sholto dead... Enter Athelney Jones... He immediately arrests Thaddeus Sholto.

Holmes systematically applies this exact logic in Chapter 5 at Pondicherry Lodge... But he actually speaks this exact quote later in Chapter 6. Remembering that subtle distinction shows true mastery of the text.

flagged.title: Character Analysis
flagged.reason: The video quotes 'a firm set of lips' as direct textual evidence for Mary Morstan, teaching students an inaccurate quotation that is not present in the novel.

mark_affecting.quote: Watson actually describes her as having 'a sweet and amiable' expression, but crucially paired with 'a firm set of lips'.
